profiles.Summary: Supermarket Together is a casual co-op simulation with modest PC minimum requirements (GTX 960), putting it within reach of the Steam Deck's RDNA 2 GPU, though performance can degrade significantly with heavy shop decoration and many simultaneous players. With sensible settings it should hold 40–60 fps in typical play, but crowded multiplayer sessions or heavily decorated shops may cause dips.
